Plan your live wedding music

  • Choose a few must-have songs and a few you would rather avoid; check the current repertoire on each band’s profile.
  • Compare the exact lineup being quoted. Brass, additional singers and acoustic options vary between bands and packages.
  • Ask your venue about stage space, power, access, sound limiters and the music curfew before finalising the lineup.
  • Plan the first dance, live sets and music between sets together. Confirm any song-learning or DJ options in your quote.

Explore our venue guide for venue and room information.

Your questions answered

What is the difference between a funk, soul and Motown wedding band?

Funk puts the emphasis on rhythm and dance grooves; soul focuses on expressive vocals; Motown refers to the classic sound and songs associated with the label. Many wedding bands blend these styles. Use the repertoire and live videos to choose the balance you prefer.

Can we add saxophone or a brass section?

These bands offer different lineup choices, including brass options. Check the individual profile and ask which instruments are included in the lineup quoted for your wedding; a larger lineup should not be assumed from a promotional video.

How much does a funk or soul wedding band cost?

The quote depends on the act, lineup, date, venue, travel and performance requirements. Add your date and venue to explore pricing, or send those details to our team for a quote covering your chosen options.
